Klasse GameUtils.Ring

java.lang.Object
feu.agenten.shogo_seifert.GameUtils.Ring
Umschließende Klasse:
GameUtils
public static class GameUtils.Ring extends Object
Collection of helper methods related to the ring.

The collection includes index correction, distance calculation, neighbor checks and visibility related operations.

    • correctIndex

      public static int correctIndex(int index, int ringSize)
      Returns the correct index on the ring.
      Parameter:
      index - the given index
      ringSize - the size of the ring
      Gibt zurück:
      an index within the ring bounds

    • getVisibility

      public static int getVisibility(List<Node> ring)
      Returns the absolute visibility by calculating the amount of neutral nodes used in the very beginning of the game.
      Parameter:
      ring - list of Nodes forming the ring
      Gibt zurück:
      value of the absolute visibility

      public static int distanceOnRing(int a, int b, int ringSize)

      Gibt zurück:

      public static int nextEnemyRight(int startIndex, List<Node> ring)
